svg.text: Activity: virtual card issue, fund and freeze
The card number never touches our servers. We store the issuer token and last four digits only, which keeps PCI scope small.
Show fee and terms, ask for PIN
Store token and last four, status
Add money to the card from
Pre-funded model shown. With just-in-time funding
the issuer asks us to approve each purchase and we
check the wallet at that moment.
